# OpsRadar — Agent Context

**OpsRadar** is an AI-powered operations audit tool for agencies. Users complete a multi-step questionnaire and receive an automation audit generated by GPT-4o.

## Stack
- Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- Supabase (PostgreSQL + auth), Upstash Redis (rate limiting)
- OpenAI GPT-4o, Resend (email), Vercel (hosting)

## Path Alias
`<npm>/*` → `./src/*` — use `<npm>/lib/...`, `<npm>/components/...` in all imports.

## Key Files
- `src/app/api/generate-audit/route.ts` — core audit generation endpoint
- `src/lib/knowledge-retrieval.ts` — file-based KB retrieval (no embeddings, reads `knowledge-base/` dirs)
- `src/lib/agency-submissions.ts` — quality filter + save qualifying audit inputs to Supabase
- `src/lib/prompts.ts` — GPT-4o prompt templates
- `src/lib/website-intel.ts` — SSRF-safe website scraping pipeline
- `src/lib/supabase-server.ts` — server-side Supabase client (service role)
- `src/lib/admin-session.ts` — admin session signing (requires `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`)
- `src/lib/security-server.ts` — shared security utilities

## Security Rules
- Never use the browser-side Supabase client (`src/lib/supabase.ts`) for sensitive data — use server-side routes only
- All admin data access goes through `/api/admin/` routes, never direct from the browser
- Rate limiting is enforced via Upstash Redis on all public API routes
- `knowledge-retrieval.ts` degrades gracefully if Supabase is unavailable — never throw, always return file chunks

## Commands
```bash
npm run dev      # localhost:3000
npm run build    # production build
npm run lint     # ESLint
```
